simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֲלוּ (H431) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: inj.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֲלוּ (ʼălûw) means lo! First listed occurrence: Dan 2 31.

definitions.full: H431. alu אֲלוּ Interjection lo! (derivation uncertain: usually regarded as by-form of אֲרוּ , q. v.; compare Egyptian Aramaic הלו , Cooke No.73 , RES 492 B = S-C M b ); — וַאֲלוּ Dan 2:31 וַאֲלוּ הֲוַיְתָ חָזֵי , 4:7 ; 4:10 ; 7:8 always in description of a vision.
